current_definition: Reflect: ranged attacks against it bounce back to the attacker. Hit it up close or with area effects.
name: Reflect
definition: Single-target ranged hits from more than 1 tile away bounce back to the attacker. Melee, area and Chain hits land.
note: 'Ranged attacks' was too broad: Chain, Push/Pull and splash ranged hits are never reflected. Badge copy at reflect.gd:7 must change with it.

current_definition: Dive: flies straight at you (up to %d tiles), knocking each unit it passes %d tile aside, then strikes for %d.
name: Dive
definition: Flies straight at you, giving each unit it passes Push 1 to its right. Strikes if it lands beside you.
note: Old text baked base data into %d slots (wrong once section/depth scaling applies) and said 'aside'. The damage now comes only from the intent token; ActionIconLibrary.description/dive_tooltip must stop %-formatting this entry.

current_definition: Flying: moves over traps, surfaces, Bramble and Ice Pillars and takes no surface damage. Can still be pushed.
name: Flying
definition: Moves over Bramble and Ice Pillars. Ignores traps, ground and Collision damage. Push, Pull and Wind still move it.
note: Collision immunity was missing (Bramble still Bleeds it).

current_definition: Bramble: blocks movement for 3 more round(s). A unit pushed into it takes 2 damage and Bleeds.
name: Bramble
definition: Blocks movement, not sight, for 3 enemy turns. A unit forced into it takes 2 damage and Bleed 1.
note: Label 'Thornwall' was the intent name; the board object is Bramble. Lifetime counts enemy turns (every enemy, including the grow turn), not rounds; 'pushed' also covers Pull. Copies at bramble_view.gd:14 and bramble.gd:97 must follow.

current_definition: Lob Slag
name: Lob Slag
definition: Marks your tile and the 4 around it. On its next turn, they take the shown damage and become Fire.
note: Old entry had no definition (tooltip read 'Lob Slag / Lob Slag'). Centre tile takes more than the arms; the token shows both.

current_definition: Charge <n>/3: at 3 it discharges chain lightning.
name: Charge
definition: Builds 1 Charge per use. At 3, its next turn fires lightning that jumps between nearby units. Shock removes 1.
director_decision_needed: The Storm Capacitor's intent is named 'Discharge', colliding with the Discharge card keyword. Rename the intent (e.g. 'Chain Burst')?
note: It declares at 3 and fires next turn; a fresh Shock removes 1 Charge and cancels a declared discharge. The <n> placeholder is gone (the badge live line shows n/3). The capacitor's intent is also named 'Discharge', which collides with the Discharge card keyword.

current_definition: Mirror: it copies the last attack you played — <card>: <damage> damage.
name: Mirror
definition: Copies your last damaging card at base damage, without its effects. The copy is fixed when declared.
note: Literal <card>/<damage> placeholders removed (the intent name already shows 'Mirror: <card>').

current_definition: Icefall: icicles fall on the marked tiles on the Seer's next turn.
name: Icefall
definition: Marks 3 tiles across your tile. Next turn they take the shown damage; empty ones become Ice Pillars.
director_decision_needed: Ice Pillar (Icefall terrain, also named in Flying) has no glossary entry or icon. Add one?
note: Old text omitted the damage and the Ice Pillars. Ice Pillars block movement and sight; a unit forced into one takes 2 and shatters it. Chilled targets Freeze (Ice hit).

current_definition: Wind: at the end of each enemy turn, everything not anchored is pushed one tile with the wind.
name: Wind
definition: After each of the next 2 enemy turns, Push every unit 1 tile downwind. Anchored units and bosses are immune.
note: 'Not anchored' was misleading: bosses, guardians, constructs, objective leaders and burrowed units are immune too. Also wind_view.gd:172.

current_definition: Tether: lightning strikes every tile between the two Arc Thralls for 4 and Shocks. Break the line to stop it.
name: Tether
definition: Every unit between two aligned Arc Thralls takes the shown damage and Shock. Terrain between them stops it.
note: 'for 4' was hard-coded (depth scaling adds damage). Standing in the line does not break it; only killing/moving a Thrall or terrain between them does.

current_definition: Veiled: only attacks from an adjacent tile, or area effects, can hit it.
name: Veiled
definition: You can target it only from an adjacent tile. Untargeted hits, like Area Attacks and Chain, still land.
note: Old text missed that Chain, conduction and Sweeping Strike also hit, and that reach melee from 2 tiles is blocked.

current_definition: Burrowed; marks your current tile. Erupt is its next intent.
name: Burrow
definition: Burrows and marks your tile; Erupt comes next. Burrowed, it can't be targeted or moved, but Area Attacks hit it.

current_definition: Surfaces at the mark, displaces its occupant, pushes adjacent units, leaves Rubble and gains Expose 2.
name: Erupt
definition: Emerges at the mark, hitting and displacing its occupant. Neighbors get Push 1. Leaves Rubble; gains Expose 2.
note: Old text omitted the damage on the marked tile; 'Surfaces' clashed with the ground noun. Falls back to the nearest free tile if the mark is blocked.

current_definition: When this dies, it deals the shown damage to everything next to it.
name: Bursts
definition: When it dies, it deals the shown damage to every unit in the 8 tiles around it, then leaves Fire.
note: 'Next to it' means the 4 orthogonal tiles everywhere else, but Burst hits all 8; the Fire it leaves was missing. Badge copy at death_burst_view.gd:22.

current_definition: Spend 1 independent Move and all Stoneskin. Place cover within 2 with that much HP.
name: Raise Cover
definition: Spend 1 independent Move and all Stoneskin. Place cover within 2 with that much HP.
director_decision_needed: Raise Cover has no live mechanic. Delete the entry (recommended) or keep for a future relic?
note: No action maps to this icon; the mechanic does not exist (the relic it was designed for now raises an outcrop).

current_definition: Spend 1 independent Move to remove adjacent owned cover and recover its surviving HP as Stoneskin.
name: Reclaim Cover
definition: Spend 1 independent Move to remove adjacent owned cover and recover its surviving HP as Stoneskin.
director_decision_needed: Reclaim Cover has no live mechanic. Delete the entry (recommended)?
note: No live mechanic.

current_definition: Creates a surface in the shown area.
name: Shape Ground
definition: Place the shown ground on the shown tiles. A tile holds Rubble plus one other ground.
note: Current 'Creates a surface in the shown area' uses 'surface'; family noun is now 'ground'. Rubble is a separate layer; Fire/Ice/Electrified replace each other.

current_definition: Deals 3 damage on turn start and 2 damage when entered.
name: Fire
definition: A unit that enters takes 2 damage. One that starts its turn here takes 3.
director_decision_needed: Fire and Ice each name both a ground and an element; glossary.gd attaches no panel to the ambiguous plain word, and a stack can show two different 'Fire' panels. Keep the shared names (proposed; text uses @icon tokens where both matter) or rename the grounds?
note: Says whose turn start; Flying units are exempt (Flying entry).

current_definition: Entering or starting a turn on Ice applies Chilled.
name: Ice
definition: A unit that enters or starts its turn here is Chilled until it leaves.
note: Adds the duration (sync_chilled clears ground Chill off Ice).

current_definition: Lightning spreads through connected Electrified tiles. Chain can jump through these tiles to reach other targets.
name: Electrified
definition: A Lightning hit that touches it spreads to every foe on connected Electrified tiles. Chain relays through it.
note: Conduction needs a damaging Lightning hit; it hits the attacker's foes only.

current_definition: Costs 2 movement to leave.
name: Rubble
definition: Costs 2 movement to leave.

current_definition: Takes +2 attack damage. An Ice hit Freezes this character and consumes the Ice beneath them.
name: Chilled
definition: Takes 2 more damage from attacks. An Ice attack Freezes it and Expends the Ice beneath.
note: Uses Expend for ground removal. Glossary text is correct; the Grimoire copy (data/grimoire.json entries/88) wrongly says 'while on Ice' (relic Chill persists off Ice, surface_variety_relic_rules.gd:123-125) and must change.

current_definition: Consumes Fire tiles to damage targets on them and their four neighboring tiles.
name: Detonate
definition: Expend the chosen Fire, or the shown ground. Hit everyone on those tiles and next to them once, including you.
note: Old text said 'targets' and 'Fire tiles'; the blast hits every unit, you and your illusions included, unless the card shows 'spares you' (only Immolation), and Magma Vent / Basalt Kiln detonate Rubble.

current_definition: Consumes the shown surface to gain its reward.
name: Expend
definition: Remove the shown ground from its tile to power the listed effect.
director_decision_needed: Surface-removal verb: Expend (proposed; no collisions) or Spend (already in the 'Spend Rubble · redirect' label, but collides with spending Stoneskin, Time and skill points)?
note: Renamed from 'Consume Ground' so removing ground never shares a word with the item keyword Consume. Quarry Winch (id briar_winch, data/relics.json:1360) proposed text: 'Your @icon(push) and @icon(pull) can Expend @icon(surface_rubble) under an enemy to move it in any of the 4 directions.' (19 words; rules: surface_relic_rules.gd:59-61, 91-92, 141-145, 164-166; combat_engine.gd:6788-6791). The prose word Expend then resolves to this entry, so glossary.gd TODO_DESIGN_GLOSSARY_CONSUME_PROSE can be deleted.

current_definition: Moves a surface to another tile.
name: Relocate Ground
definition: Move one ground tile to another open tile.

current_definition: Deals damage up close.
name: Melee
definition: Deal that much damage to an adjacent target, or one within the shown Range.

current_definition: Deals damage from a distance.
name: Ranged
definition: Deal that much damage to a target within Range and line of sight.

current_definition: Deals damage straight through block and stoneskin.
name: Pierce
definition: This damage ignores Block and Stoneskin.

current_definition: Moves across board tiles.
name: Move
definition: Walk up to that many tiles around obstacles. Ground and traps you enter take effect.

current_definition: Moves away from the target.
name: Retreat
definition: Moves up to that many tiles away from its target.

current_definition: Teleports to another tile.
name: Blink
definition: Teleport to a visible open tile within that many tiles, ignoring anything between.

current_definition: Maximum target distance in tiles.
name: Range
definition: Maximum distance in tiles, counted without diagonals.

current_definition: Absorbs damage until your next turn.
name: Block
definition: Absorbs damage before Health. Lost at the start of its holder's next turn.
note: 'until your next turn' is wrong for enemy Block, which ends at the enemy's own turn start (Petrify Block survives the skipped turn).

current_definition: Persistent armor that absorbs damage across turns.
name: Stoneskin
definition: Absorbs damage after Block. Lasts until used up or combat ends.

current_definition: Restores health.
name: Heal
definition: Restore that much Health, up to the maximum.

current_definition: Adds cards to your hand.
name: Draw
definition: Draw that many cards. Your hand holds at most 7.

current_definition: Adds card plays for this turn.
name: Card Play
definition: Playing a card spends 1. Refills each turn. Killing an enemy on your turn grants 1 more, except summons.
note: Old text described only the +N token. Kill refund: not summoned, credited on your turn.

current_definition: Repeats this card once per remaining card play, spending them all. Pays Time once.
name: Flurry
definition: Repeat this card once per Card Play left, spending them all, on the same target. Pay its Time once.

current_definition: Gains the listed bonus if you already played a card this turn.
name: Follow-up
definition: If you already played a card this turn: gain the listed bonus.

current_definition: Optional: pay the listed extra cost while playing this card to gain the listed bonus.
name: Empower
definition: You can pay the listed extra cost as you play this card to gain the listed bonus.

current_definition: Delays the target's next turn by this much Time. Dragons take half. At most 6 per enemy each turn.
name: Stagger
definition: Delays the target's next turn by this much Time. Dragons take half. At most 6 per enemy each turn.

current_definition: Delays your next turn. Each unused play takes 5.
name: Time
definition: Cards cost Time; the more you spend, the later your next turn. Playing under 2 cards adds Wait.
note: Audit finding: 'each unused play takes 5' ignores the cap; Wait counts only the 2 base plays (bonus and banked plays never add Wait). The Wait rule moves to its own new entry. The Time icon is also reused as a duration chip (light, Vision, Truesight, Eclipse turns); see director question on the wait/turns entries.

current_definition: Creates a stationary copy that enemies can target.
name: Illusion
definition: Create a decoy with that much Health. Enemies attack it when it's at least as close as you.

current_definition: Creates a light that reveals nearby Umbra tiles.
name: Light
definition: Reveals tiles within its radius through the Umbra for the shown number of your turns.
note: Cards, selectors and conditions all say 'Light' (create Light, in Light); only the icon label and Grimoire title say 'Illuminate'.

current_definition: Expands the light centered on you.
name: Vision
definition: Widen your sight radius by that much for the shown turns. It creates no Light.
note: Old text 'Expands the light centered on you' is wrong: Vision adds sight radius and is never a light source (Light checks ignore it). Grimoire entry repeats the error.

current_definition: Reveals and permits targeting enemies through the Umbra.
name: Truesight
definition: For the shown turns, every enemy counts as visible: you see its intent and can target it.
note: Range and line of sight still apply; tiles stay dark.

current_definition: Reduces this combat's Umbra stage.
name: Dispel Umbra
definition: Lower the Umbra by that many stages for the rest of this combat.

current_definition: Forces the arena into absolute Umbra. Radiance and light offer protection.
name: Eclipse
definition: The darkest Umbra stage: you see only 1 tile around you. Light still reveals; Dispel Umbra lowers it.
note: The Umbra stage, distinct from the Last Eclipse attack that forces it.

current_definition: Deals damage before moving or attacking. Lasts through the next turn.
name: Bleed
definition: Before each move or attack, it takes damage equal to its Bleed. Clears when its turn ends.
note: Old 'Deals damage' hid that the amount equals the Bleed value; 'lasts through the next turn' is wrong when Bleed lands during the bearer's own turn (Retaliate), since it clears at that turn's end.

current_definition: The next hit against this target deals extra damage.
name: Expose
definition: The next attack that damages it deals that much more damage. Then Expose ends.

current_definition: Breaks block and stoneskin before damage lands.
name: Sunder
definition: Before damage, remove up to that much Block, then Stoneskin, from the target.
note: Old text implied all Block and Stoneskin break; Sunder N removes at most N.

current_definition: Removes this card from the deck for the rest of combat.
name: Exhaust
definition: After use, this card leaves your deck until combat ends.

current_definition: Uses this item card once, then removes it from the run.
name: Consume
definition: After use, this item is gone for the rest of the run.

current_definition: Until your next turn, an enemy that hits you in melee takes this much damage (Block and Stoneskin absorb it) and any listed riders. Several Retaliates add up.
name: Retaliate
definition: Until your next turn, each enemy that hits you up close takes that much damage and the listed effects.
note: 'up close' = a melee action or any attack from an adjacent tile.

current_definition: Your next card this turn costs this much less Time (minimum 1). Several Quickens add up; unused Quicken ends with your turn.
name: Quicken
definition: Your next card this turn costs that much less Time, minimum 1. Unused Quicken ends with your turn.

current_definition: Rite: Exhaust. Lasts for the rest of this combat.
name: Rite
definition: Its effect lasts for the rest of this combat. Exhaust.

current_definition: Your next attack on a later card this turn gains the shown bonus, then the bonus is spent. Unused bonuses end with your turn.
name: Next Attack
definition: Your next attack on a later card this turn gets the shown bonus. Unused bonuses end with your turn.

current_definition: Swap places with a visible one-tile enemy or one of your illusions. Both of you arrive normally; nothing collides, and Anchored does not stop it.
name: Swap
definition: Trade places with a visible one-tile enemy or your illusion. Both trigger the ground where they land.

current_definition: The enemy skips its next turn (the skipped turn still costs its Time) and gains Block that lasts through your next turn. Not Freeze: no extra damage. Dragons are immune.
name: Petrify
definition: Skips its next turn, still paying its Time. Gains the shown Block, kept through that turn. Dragons are immune.

current_definition: Removes the listed statuses from you: Bleed, Immobilize, Chilled or Shock.
name: Cleanse
definition: Remove the listed statuses from yourself.

current_definition: This turn, moving onto Ice costs no movement and Ice doesn't Chill you.
name: Skate
definition: This turn, stepping onto Ice costs no movement, and Ice doesn't make you Chilled.

current_definition: Until your next turn, you can't be pushed or pulled: Push and Pull move you 0 tiles and never collide.
name: Anchored
definition: Push, Pull and Wind don't move it or cause a Collision. Yours lasts until your next turn.
note: Enemies can be Anchored too (enemy data 'anchored'), and Anchored also stops Wind.

current_definition: Fire doesn't damage you this turn.
name: Fireproof
definition: This turn, Fire ground doesn't damage you.
note: Only ground Fire; Fire-element attacks still hit.

current_definition: Turns the chosen surface tile, and every tile of it connected to it when shown, into another surface. Each enemy on a converted tile takes the damage.
name: Convert Ground
definition: Turn the chosen ground tile, and its connected tiles when shown, into another ground. Hit each enemy on them.

current_definition: Removes a connected Electrified network. Each enemy on it or next to it takes the damage once.
name: Discharge
definition: Remove a connected Electrified network. Hit each enemy on it or next to it once.

current_definition: Hits every enemy you can see that meets the shown condition. There is no target to choose, and enemies hidden by the Umbra are never hit.
name: Sweeping Strike
definition: Hit every enemy you can see that meets the shown condition, within Range if shown. No target to choose.

current_definition: You and one of your illusions trade tiles. Both of you trigger the ground and traps where you land. Immobilize prevents it.
name: Swap Illusion
definition: Trade places with one of your illusions. Both trigger the ground where they land.
director_decision_needed: Swap Illusion is Swap restricted to your illusions (illusion_card_rules.gd:335-357 vs maneuver_rules.gd:434-470). Merge into Swap (one glossary entry; the illusion_swap icon would then need retiring or re-pointing under the icon identity policy) or keep both?

current_definition: Destroys one of your illusions to blast each enemy next to it.
name: Shatter Illusion
definition: Destroy one of your illusions in range. Hit each enemy next to it.

current_definition: Skips the next turn and takes triple attack damage.
name: Freeze
definition: Skips its next turn. Takes triple damage from attacks until then.

current_definition: Cancels the next non-movement action.
name: Shock
definition: On its next turn, it can only Move or Blink.
note: Old text said it cancels the next non-movement action; code cancels every non-movement action of the whole next turn.

current_definition: Prevents movement and Blink next turn.
name: Immobilize
definition: Can't Move, Blink or Swap during its next turn.
note: Old text omitted Swap. 'Rooted' (self-applied, this turn) is renamed to Immobilize; its token keeps a 'this turn' override.

current_definition: Jumps between targets within the shown range. Electrified tiles extend its reach.
name: Chain
definition: Jump to a new target within that many tiles, repeating from each one. Electrified tiles relay the jump.
note: The value is jump distance, not a jump count; jumps continue while a new target is in reach. The Storm Capacitor's discharge (chain_discharge) ignores Electrified tiles, so its alias moves to Charge.

current_definition: Forces the target away in one straight line. If it's stopped early, it collides.
name: Push
definition: Move the target that many tiles straight away from the source. If blocked: Collision.

current_definition: Forces the target closer in one straight line. If it's stopped early, it collides.
name: Pull
definition: Move the target that many tiles straight toward the source. If blocked before reaching it: Collision.
note: A Pull that reaches its source stops without colliding.

current_definition: A stopped Push or Pull deals 2 damage per tile not moved to the target and to whatever stopped it. Walls take nothing. Block and Stoneskin absorb it.
name: Collision
definition: A stopped Push or Pull deals 2 damage per lost tile to the target and to its blocker.

current_definition: Health paid or restored.
name: Health
definition: At 0 Health a unit is defeated or terrain breaks. Your Health carries over between rooms.
note: Icon also marks max Health and terrain Health, not only 'paid or restored'.

current_definition: Health paid to play this card.
name: Health Cost
definition: Lose that much Health when the card finishes. Block and Stoneskin don't prevent it.
note: Paid after the card resolves, bypassing Block (old text implied a cost paid up front).

current_definition: Affects a pattern of board tiles.
name: Area Attack
definition: Hits each foe on the pattern's red tiles, seen or unseen.

current_definition: Calls down lightning across several marked tiles.
name: Lightning Strikes
definition: Strikes the marked tiles for the shown damage, then turns them Electrified, replacing its old field.
note: The count chip uses the Shock icon though no Shock is applied (AIL:1430).

current_definition: Adds new enemy units to the battle.
name: Summon
definition: Calls the shown enemy, up to a limit of living ones. Killing a summon grants no Card Play.

current_definition: Creates attackable terrain on the board.
name: Raise Terrain
definition: Raises attackable terrain with the shown Health. It blocks movement; some kinds also block sight.

current_definition: Ruptures the arena around surviving terrain.
name: Terrain Burst
definition: Hits units around terrain pieces for the shown damage. Some uses destroy the terrain too.
note: 'Around surviving terrain' was wrong for Faultline and the player's Rockburst/Worldbreak, which destroy the terrain.

current_definition: Creates Fire on the marked tiles.
name: Cinder Marks
definition: Marks the shown tiles. When it lands, they take the shown damage and become Fire.
note: Renamed from 'Kindle Ground' (clashed with the Ember Tick's Kindle); matches code id and the pre-battle tag. The player card Meteorfall lands at the start of your next turn and can hit you.

current_definition: Consumes Fire to damage targets on it and its four neighboring tiles.
name: Crownfire
definition: Detonate the Fire on its last Cinder Marks. Everyone caught is hit once, the dragon included.
note: Same code as Detonate; kept separate because the fuel is only its own marked Fire. Definition references Detonate instead of re-explaining it.

current_definition: Sweeps the target through the arena.
name: Hollow Gale
definition: Blasts everything within 2 tiles of the dragon with Push 2, then erupts along its last Razor Dive path.
director_decision_needed: gale_force has no live action. Point Vaeloryx's Hollow Gale intent at this icon (so the definition shows in combat) or drop the entry?
note: Old text described the dormant gale_force action; the live Hollow Gale intent uses aoe actions and this icon only appears on the Grimoire entry.

current_definition: Each layer prevents one direct damaging hit, then breaks.
name: Crystal Mantle
definition: Each layer cancels 1 direct hit, then breaks. Ground damage, Bleed, Collision and traps bypass it.

current_definition: Grants block to another enemy.
name: Guard Ally
definition: Gives the shown Block to one or more enemies, sometimes including itself.
note: 'Another enemy' was wrong: Grave Surgeon and Glacial Mirror can guard themselves; Stone Warden guards all others at once.

current_definition: Restores another enemy's health.
name: Heal Ally
definition: Restores the shown Health to a wounded enemy, possibly itself.
note: 'Another enemy's health' was wrong: Grave Surgeon can heal itself; only wounded enemies are targeted.

current_definition: Forces the arena into absolute Umbra.
name: Last Eclipse
definition: Unprotected targets take the shown damage, then the Umbra becomes Eclipse for 2 turns. Light, Vision and Truesight protect you.
note: Old text omitted the damage and duration; 'absolute Umbra' overstated it. Dispel Umbra also protects.

current_definition: Carries protective light into the Umbra.
name: Radiance
definition: Cards and skills that counter the Umbra with Light, Vision, Truesight and Dispel Umbra.
note: 'Carries protective light' is wrong for Radiance cards that make no light; it is a card school and skill branch.

current_definition: Run currency used to gain permanent levels.
name: Embers
definition: Earned from kills and victories. Spend them on wares and levels. Dying drops them; recover them next run.
note: Old 'Run currency used to gain permanent levels' omits the Scavenger and the death drop, and the bank carries between runs.

current_definition: The full journey from entry to victory or defeat.
name: The Run
definition: One attempt through 6 sections, each ending in a dragon. Ends at the last dragon, at defeat or by Embrace.

current_definition: Routes and room types across the labyrinth.
name: Map and Rooms
definition: Each section is a map of rooms. Pick a forward route through combat, Relic, Scavenger, Ember Hearth and other rooms.
note: Grimoire basics (entries/3-4 region, G:63-64) still describe the old circular map and 'merchant'/'treasure' rooms; fix there.

current_definition: Equipment, attuned magic, items, relics, and skills.
name: Character
definition: The menu for your gear, attuned magic, items and skills. Your gear, magic and items make up your deck.
note: Relics are not part of the loadout (they live in the top HUD). Name matches the menu title and the Skill Point text.

current_definition: Cards, healing, and other prizes claimed during a run.
name: Rewards
definition: After a combat, choose 1 of 3 magic cards, or skip to heal 3. Dragons and Guardians also give relics.

current_definition: Passive run modifiers collected during exploration.
name: Relics
definition: Passive effects that last the whole run. Found in Relic rooms and won from dragons and Guardians.

current_definition: The tactical tile grid where actions resolve.
name: Combat Board
definition: The 9×9 tile grid where combat happens.

current_definition: Orders the next actor by current initiative delay.
name: Turn Clock
definition: Each unit has a next-turn time; the lowest acts next, and you win ties. Spending Time pushes yours later.
note: Grimoire turn-clock text (G:125-126) is stale: no base 9 and no Wait rule.

current_definition: Health protected by block and stoneskin.
name: Health and Defenses
definition: Damage hits Block first, then Stoneskin, then Health. Pierce skips Block and Stoneskin.

current_definition: A per-run rescue that restores health after lethal loss.
name: Defiance
definition: Each charge turns lethal damage into 25% Health. You get 1 per 4 levels, refilled each run.
note: Old 'A per-run rescue' implies one; charges are floor(level/4) plus relic/event charges.

current_definition: Range, line of sight, patterns, and legal targets.
name: Targeting
definition: Targets must be visible and within Range. Ranged attacks also need line of sight; walls and outcrops block it.

current_definition: Direct health loss caused by reshuffling an empty deck.
name: Fatigue
definition: When you must draw from an empty draw pile, reshuffle your discard and lose 2 Health, +1 each time.
note: Amount and escalation were missing. Code note: CE:7773 passes apply_freeze_multiplier=true, so Expose/Chilled/Frozen amplify Fatigue, unlike the health-cost path; confirm intent.

current_definition: Board hazards triggered by movement or attacks.
name: Traps
definition: Trigger once when entered or hit. They damage their tile and spread their element to the 4 tiles around.
note: Air traps 'spread' as a Push 1 outward (CE:7359-7369); Flying units never trigger traps.

current_definition: Darkness that conceals tiles, enemies, and threats.
name: The Umbra
definition: Darkness that limits your sight. Hidden enemies show no intent and can't be targeted, but Area Attacks still hit them.

current_definition: Tharokh's attackable stone spires.
name: Worldspines
definition: Attackable stone spires that block movement, not sight. Destroyed ones leave Rubble. Damage pulses out around them.
note: Not only Tharokh's: the Worldspine card raises them for the player.

current_definition: Shapes dangerous ground and consumes it in powerful blasts.
name: Fire
definition: Card element. Fire cards mostly place Fire ground and Detonate it.
evidence: data/cards.json element=fire: 22 of 35 cards place Fire, 8 Detonate

current_definition: Prepares Ice, Chills exposed units and Freezes with a later Ice hit.
name: Ice
definition: Card element. Ice cards place Ice ground, and an Ice attack Freezes a Chilled target.
evidence: data/cards.json element=ice: 16 of 35 cards place Ice
note: Old 'Chills exposed units' collided with Expose; ground Ice Chills, not the card.

current_definition: Conducts through Electrified ground and rewards connected targets.
name: Lightning
definition: Card element. Lightning cards place Electrified ground; a damaging Lightning attack spreads through it.
evidence: data/cards.json element=lightning: 17 of 34 cards place Electrified

current_definition: Controls positioning with movement, Push and Pull.
name: Air
definition: Card element. Air cards move units with Push and Pull, and move you.
evidence: data/cards.json element=air: Push/Pull/force_area on 22 of 30 action rows, Move 6

current_definition: Creates Rubble and persistent Stoneskin defense.
name: Earth
definition: Card element. Earth cards leave Rubble, raise terrain and grant Stoneskin.
evidence: data/cards.json element=earth: 20 of 34 cards leave Rubble, 12 Stoneskin, 6 outcrops

current_definition: Once per combat, discard a card to gain @icon(draw) 1. Costs no @icon(card_play) or @icon(time).
name: Quick Wits
definition: Once per combat, discard a card to gain @icon(draw) 1. Costs no @icon(card_play) or @icon(time).

current_definition: At turn end, bank up to one unused @icon(card_play) for your next turn.
name: Measured Breath
definition: At the end of your turn, bank 1 unused @icon(card_play) for your next turn. Wait still applies.
note: Fixed trigger phrase; banking does not waive Wait.

current_definition: Once per combat, activate to turn your next movement into @icon(blink) 2.
name: Ghost Stride
definition: Once per combat, activate to make your next free move a @icon(blink) of up to 2 tiles.
note: Only the free per-turn movement converts; card Moves never do.

current_definition: Once between bosses, replace every card in a combat reward.
name: Discerning Eye
definition: Once between bosses, replace every card in a non-boss combat reward with new ones.
note: Refused for dragon and event rewards.

current_definition: Once per combat, activate to discard your next non-item @icon(exhaust) card after use.
name: Rehearsed Escape
definition: Once per combat, activate to send your next non-item @icon(exhaust) card to your discard instead.

current_definition: Once per combat, activate to discard your next item after use instead of @icon(consume).
name: Makeshift Tool
definition: Once per combat, activate to send your next item to your discard instead of @icon(consume).

current_definition: Once per combat, activate while you have @icon(block) to convert your remaining @icon(block) into @icon(stoneskin) at turn end.
name: Carry the Guard
definition: Once per combat, activate while you have @icon(block): at the end of your turn, it becomes @icon(stoneskin).

current_definition: After you first lose @icon(health) each combat, the next non-item card discarded while your hand has room returns to it.
name: Pain Remembers
definition: The first time each combat you lose @icon(health), the next non-item card put in your discard returns to your hand.
note: Waits while your hand is full or the card is an item.

current_definition: Once per combat, ignore the first @icon(traps) hit or Air @icon(traps) @icon(push) against you.
name: Sure-Footed
definition: Once per combat, take no damage from the first @icon(traps) that hits you.
director_decision_needed: Sure-Footed: drop the Air-push clause (proposed text) or implement protect_air_push so the old text becomes true?
note: Old 'or Air Traps Push against you' is false: the Air push has no Sure-Footed check and skills.json protect_air_push/preserve_wake are read nowhere. spec/meta_leveling.md:150 repeats the claim.

current_definition: Once per combat, your first @icon(blink) leaves an @icon(illusion) 2 at its origin.
name: Afterimage
definition: The first time each combat you @icon(blink), leave an @icon(illusion) 2 where you started.

current_definition: Skip a card reward to save one offered card. It replaces one card in your next reward.
name: Deferred Choice
definition: Skip a card reward to save 1 offered card. It replaces 1 card in your next non-boss card reward.
note: Boss rewards skip the saved card.

current_definition: Once between bosses, recover the first equipment drop left uncollected after victory.
name: Salvager
definition: Once between bosses, recover the first equipment drop left uncollected after victory.

current_definition: The first card paid for with a banked @icon(card_play) each combat adds no @icon(time).
name: Borrowed Time
definition: The first card paid for with a banked @icon(card_play) each combat adds no @icon(time).
note: An Empower Time surcharge is still paid.

current_definition: Once per combat, lethal @icon(fatigue) leaves you at @icon(health) 1.
name: Last Reserve
definition: Once per combat, lethal @icon(fatigue) leaves you at @icon(health) 1.

current_definition: The first @icon(move) or @icon(blink) to collect loot each combat refunds its @icon(card_play).
name: Plunderer's Step
definition: The first time each combat a card's @icon(move) or @icon(blink) collects loot, gain 1 @icon(card_play).
note: Free movement never triggers it; 'refunds its card play' is a +1 card play this turn.

current_definition: Once per combat, place @icon(surface_fire), @icon(surface_ice), @icon(surface_electrified) or @icon(surface_rubble) within @icon(range) 4. Costs no @icon(card_play) or @icon(time).
name: Prismatic Instinct
definition: Once per combat, place any ground on a visible tile within @icon(range) 4. Costs no @icon(card_play) or @icon(time).
note: Adds the visible-tile requirement; 'any ground' replaces four icons to stay within 20 words.

current_definition: After choosing a relic, save one unchosen relic for your next relic offer.
name: Curator's Patience
definition: After choosing a relic, save 1 unchosen relic for your next relic offer.

current_definition: Once between your turns, when @icon(illusion) is destroyed or dispelled, return your most recently discarded non-item card to hand—or put it atop your draw pile if your hand is full.
name: Living Shadow
definition: Once per turn, when an @icon(illusion) is removed, return your latest non-item discard to hand.
note: 31 words cut to 15. Full-hand fallback (top of draw pile) dropped for length.

current_definition: Before combat, choose an open starting tile within @icon(range) 2 of the entrance.
name: True Bearing
definition: Before combat, choose an open starting tile within @icon(range) 2 of the entrance.

current_definition: Once between bosses, hold one ware for the next Scavenger visit. A pending hold blocks future uses until it returns.
name: Layaway
definition: Once between bosses, hold one ware for the next Scavenger visit. A pending hold blocks future uses until it returns.
director_decision_needed: Layaway is retired (run_engine.gd:782-787). Delete its glossary entry?
note: Retired skill: excluded from run_skill_ids, never shown.

current_definition: Once per combat, return a non-item card from discard to your hand. Costs no @icon(card_play) or @icon(time).
name: Encore
definition: Once per combat, return a non-item card from discard to your hand. Costs no @icon(card_play) or @icon(time).

current_definition: Equip any equipment in your trinket slot.
name: Open Arsenal
definition: Equip any equipment in your trinket slot.

current_definition: Once per combat, @icon(surface_relocate) one surface up to @icon(range) 4. Both tiles must be visible and within @icon(range) 4 of you.
name: Confluence
definition: Once per combat, @icon(surface_relocate) 1 ground tile. Both tiles must be visible, within @icon(range) 4 of you and each other.
note: Was 21 words; now states the source-to-destination limit too.

current_definition: Once between bosses, a non-boss defeat returns you to the previous room at @icon(health) 1.
name: Last Door
definition: Once between bosses, a non-boss defeat returns you to the previous room at @icon(health) 1.

current_definition: Temporary @icon(illuminate), @icon(vision), and @icon(truesight) you create last @icon(time) +1.
name: Long Dawn
definition: Temporary @icon(illuminate), @icon(vision) and @icon(truesight) you create last 1 more turn.
note: '@icon(time) +1' read as +1 Time on the turn clock; the unit is your turns.

current_definition: The first @icon(move) or @icon(blink) 3+ each turn leaves @icon(illuminate) 1 @icon(time) 2 on every tile entered. @icon(blink) also covers its origin and destination.
name: Sunpath
definition: Once per turn, when you @icon(move) or @icon(blink) 3+ tiles, leave @icon(illuminate) 1 for 2 turns on your path.
note: 28 words cut to 19; Time icon no longer used as a duration. A Blink lights only its start and end tiles. HUD bug: RS:11937-11940 reads the wrong flag, so SPENT never shows.

current_definition: Your @icon(illusion) have +1 @icon(illuminate) radius while they last.
name: Witchlight
definition: Your @icon(illusion) give off @icon(illuminate) 1 while they last.
note: '+1 radius' implied a base light; illusions have none without this skill or a relic.

current_definition: The first direct attack each turn against an enemy in @icon(illuminate) inflicts @icon(expose) 1.
name: Dawnbrand
definition: Your first @icon(melee), @icon(ranged), @icon(push) or @icon(pull) hit each turn on an enemy in @icon(illuminate) applies @icon(expose) 1.
note: 'direct attack' was undefined; Area and Detonate hits don't count.

current_definition: When @icon(illusion) is removed during combat, it leaves @icon(illuminate) 1 @icon(time) 2 at its final tile.
name: Afterglow
definition: When an @icon(illusion) is removed, leave @icon(illuminate) 1 for 2 turns on its tile.

current_definition: While you stand in @icon(illuminate), you have @icon(truesight).
name: Open Sky
definition: While you stand in @icon(illuminate), you have @icon(truesight).

current_definition: Earned as you level up. Spend them on skills in the Character menu.
name: Skill Point
definition: Earned as you level up. Spend them on skills in the Character menu.
note: Director-decided text (ux-03 feedback 1); verified: level N has N-1 points, spent in Character > Skills.

current_definition: You need 1 Moltshard. The first dragon defeated each run grants one.
name: Moltshards
definition: Won from your first dragon each run. Trade 1 for 250 Embers, or spend 1 to reset your skills.
note: Old text was the disabled-button requirement message (dialogue_engine.gd:128), not a definition.

name: Wait
definition: Each of your first 2 Card Plays left unused adds 5 Time to your next turn.
director_decision_needed: Wait has no icon (the Time icon belongs to Time). Text-only keyword, or commission an icon? Related: the Time icon is also reused as a 'turns remaining' chip (action_icon_library.gd:1418, 1422, 1614, 1868; relics/skills @icon(time) N), so a card hover can show two different panels titled Time. Add a separate 'Turns' duration icon and entry?
note: Gap: the style guide names Wait as a keyword and the HUD shows 'WAIT +N' (run_scene.gd:14190), but no glossary entry exists. Bonus, refunded and banked plays never add Wait; Freeze-forfeited plays do.
